summary: Market mood is broadly defensive: Bitcoin remains below $76,000, major altcoins have suffered sharp weekly losses, and spot Bitcoin ETFs recorded substantial outflows.[1] Michaël van de Poppe is cautiously bullish on a potential crypto reversal if Bitcoin and Ethereum reclaim key resistance, but the bearish trend remains intact until those levels break.[1][2]
